if(TARGET duration_objects)
add_auto_test(test_DurationInference.cpp duration_objects)
add_auto_test(test_DurationTask.cpp duration_objects)
endif()

# The duration task against small synthetic models, one that declares the word inputs of the
# duration predictor and one that does not. They are generated by
# Inference/resources/scripts/generate_onnx/duration_word_inputs.py. The test runs the interpreter
# of its objects and loads only the ONNX driver from the build tree.
if(NOT TARGET duration OR NOT TARGET onnxdriver)
    return()
endif()

# The ONNX Runtime payload that the driver loads, as the driver factory test takes it
find_package(onnxruntime-builds CONFIG QUIET)

add_auto_test(test_DurationInterpreter.cpp duration_objects
    RESOURCES
        ../../../Inference/resources/models/duration_word_encoder.onnx
        ../../../Inference/resources/models/duration_word_predictor.onnx
        ../../../Inference/resources/models/duration_division_predictor.onnx
        ../../../Inference/resources/models/duration_absolute_predictor.onnx
)
if(TARGET test_DurationInterpreter)
    add_dependencies(test_DurationInterpreter onnxdriver)
    target_compile_definitions(test_DurationInterpreter PRIVATE
        DSINFER_TEST_DRIVER_PLUGIN_PATH="$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:onnxdriver>/.."
        DSINFER_TEST_ORT_RUNTIME_DIR="${ONNXRUNTIME_BUILDS_RUNTIME_DIR}"
        DSINFER_TEST_DURATION_MANIFEST="$<TARGET_PROPERTY:duration,SOURCE_DIR>/plugin.json"
    )
endif()
